title: Counting Carbon
subtitle: A Practical Guide to Carbon Budgets, Sinks and Removal
intro: Carbon-management claims arrive in different units, over different periods and with different assumptions. This book brings them into a common frame: tonnes, rates, reservoir capacity, permanence and the resources that approaches share.
philosophy: Inspired by David MacKay’s Sustainable Energy: Without the Hot Air, the book applies common units, transparent assumptions and inspectable calculations to carbon management.
